**1.016: Download models in sets, update them all at once, and the title model downloads again.**

- **Bundles:** the Models tab starts with three sets you can download in one click: Everything (Sabich, Shakshuka, and the clean-up, title and paragraph models), Voice Typing (Sabich and Shakshuka) and Transcription (Sabich with the clean-up, title and paragraph models). Each shows what is still missing and roughly how big it is; anything already downloaded is skipped.
- **Update all:** Check for updates now checks every model and utility you have downloaded, not only the one in use. With more than one update, Update all installs them in one go.
- **Fixed:** in 1.015 the title model could fail to download ("the catalogue offers no clean-up model") if the app had last checked for updates before the title model was added.
- Ubuntu 26.04 .deb. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
